newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURK TEXTILE SECTOR REACHES WAGE SETTLEMENT.
newsitem.headline: TURK TEXTILE SECTOR REACHES WAGE SETTLEMENT.

text.p: The Turkish Textile Industry Employers' Union and Textile Worker's Union (Teksif) signed a collective agreement on Wednesday covering pay and fringe benefits for the next two years.
A statement from the Employers' Union said the agreement, which took two months to reach, covered 113 work places and 55,000 workers in Turkey's export leading sector.

According to the agreement, there will be an 85-percent rise in workers' basic wage in the first year, a 40-percent in the first half of the second year and 35 percent in the second half of the second year.
Fringe benefits including food, fuel and transport provisions have been increased by between 150 and 400 percent according to seniority.
Turkey's annual consumer price inflation was running at 79.6 percent at end-October.
